text:
customer_jordan: Hey team — after last night's SSO group sync, several of our org's API keys started getting 403 on embeddings and rerank endpoints. Generation/chat still works. Example curl response below, repeating across multiple keys. Anyone seen this?

customer_jordan: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
# HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
# {"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing scope: embeddings"}
```

olivia_cs: Ugh. Can you paste the token claims or output of the token introspect endpoint (no secrets — just the scopes string)?

customer_jordan: Pasted below (redacted):
```json
{
  "sub": "svcacct:org-123",
  "scopes": "inference,rerrank"
}
```
Note: rerank looks misspelled here (rerrank) and embeddings is absent. We did a group sync that maps SCIM groups -> role -> scopes.

mateo_eng: hmm. That misspelling + missing embed scope smells like a sync-time parser bug. Can you share the provisioning service sync logs for the run at ~2026-03-17T02:00Z? Also can you confirm whether keys were rotated or just the group sync ran?

customer_jordan: No key rotations. Sync was the only thing that changed. I grabbed the provisioning log snippet:
```
[provisioner] INFO sync run=GX9 start=2026-03-17T02:00Z
[provisioner] WARN mapping_line=42 raw_mapping="role:inference\,embeddings,rerank"
[provisioner] ERROR apply_scope tenant=org-123 message="failed to parse scopes after escape char\"
```

kai-provisioner-bot: provisioning-sync completed for run GX9 (status=completed, warnings=1). Warning: unescaped comma sequence detected in mapping_line 42. See provisioner docs: group->scope mappings should be comma-separated; backslashes are treated as escape characters.

mateo_eng: Ok that log confirms it — the SCIM export included an escaped comma (\,) and our parser treated the backslash as an escape and then truncated the remainder of the scope string. Result: scope "embeddings" dropped and "rerank" got corrupted. This is a provisioning parser bug introduced by the last mapping parser change. :grimacing:

sophia_ops: Short-term mitigation: 1) regenerate the affected API keys from the Org Admin UI (Regenerate key -> re-apply scopes) which will rebuild claims correctly; or 2) call the admin endpoint to update key scopes directly: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org-123/keys/sk_live_xxx/regenerate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer admin-token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"preserve_metadata":true}'
```
We verified regen restores embeddings scope for one test key.

customer_jordan: Tried UI regen for one key — embeddings is back and embeddings requests succeed (200). Thanks, that fixes it for now. :relieved:

mateo_eng: Long term: we'll push a parsing fix to provisioning that treats backslashes literally in mapping values (no truncation) and add unit tests for escaped commas and odd whitespace. Targeting prod deploy in the next maintenance window (ETA 2026-03-19). I'll attach the PR and changelog to the incident.

sophia_ops: Filed INC-2026-034, added mitigations and customer impact notes. Notifying SSO integration owners to sanitize mapping exports to avoid escape sequences until patch is live.

olivia_cs: I'll follow up with Jordan with timeline and workaround steps we documented. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
